assessment.question:
### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

5. The picture below shows a cube. The length, width and height of the cube are 4 metres. Find the volume of the cube.
assessment.expected_answer:
$$
\begin{array}{ll}
{V}_\text{cube} & {= s \times s \times s}\\
& {= 4 \times 4 \times 4}\\
\text{V}_{cube} & {= \text{64 m}^{3}} \\
\end{array}
$$

The volume of the cube is 64 m$^{3}$.
